channel.title: NBC Sports Fantasy Football News
channel.description: Latest player news and analysis for fantasy football from NBC Sports.

item.title: Xavier Hutchinson caught 2-of-3 targets for 13 yards in the Texans’ Week 11 win over the Colts.
item.description: Hutchinson’s three targets were a product of a game environment dominated by the Houston defense, with no player seeing more than the five targets accounted for by alpha wide receiver Nico Collins. Fantasy managers that were riding the recent production from Hutchinson were surely left disappointed in the down performance, with his next opportunity to return a usable fantasy outing coming in a Week 14 meeting with the Ravens. It remains to be seen whether Marvin Harrison Jr. will make it back in time for that contest, something that could influence the upside of Hutchinson in a zone-heavy matchup.-Mark Garcia

item.title: Tank Dell caught 3-of-4 targets for 27 yards in the Texans’ Week 11 win over the Colts.
item.description: Dell was blanked in the first half before seeing three consecutive plays drawn up for him in the third quarter, catching all of them for his complete yardage total on the evening. The team continues to take a conservative approach with the young speedster after he missed more than a year with one of the more gruesome injuries you will see, holding his fantasy value in check in the process. Dell can likely be stashed for the potential he sees his route rate increase later in the season but is likely best left on fantasy benches for the time being.-Mark Garcia

item.title: Kayshon Boutte caught both targets for 40 yards and a touchdown in the Texans’ Week 11 win over the Colts.
item.description: Boutte’s two targets were a product of minimal pass volume in a game the Texans were able to control with their defense. He made the most of the modest volume by coming down with a touchdown in the second quarter on a dime delivered by quarterback C.J. Stroud to the middle of the end zone from 24 yards out, catching the ball with the defender draped around his midsection. Boutte remains a shaky fantasy bet as nothing more than the third option through the air, with the team expecting to get back newcomer Marvin Harrison Jr. from a hamstring injury in short order. That could come as early as Week 12 considering the Texans now get a long week of preparation ahead of a meeting with the Ravens.-Mark Garcia

item.title: Nico Collins caught 3-of-5 targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in the Texans’ Week 11 win over the Colts.
item.description: Collins caught two passes, one of which went for his 42-yard touchdown, on the team’s second possession before being subject to modest pass volume due to increasingly positive game script. His touchdown grab will most certainly make an appearance on highlight reels for some time, mostly due to quarterback C.J. Stroud’s performance on the play. Stroud shrugged off a strong-side pass rusher to quickly reset his feet and deliver a strike downfield to Collins, turning a potential sack into a touchdown with the flick of his wrist. He appeared to effortlessly heave the ball 50 yards through the air without being able to step into the throw, placing the football where only Collins could catch it over the defender. Collins remains one of the league’s top talents at wide receiver but is subject to performances like this when the Texans are able to control games with their defense, which is exactly what transpired here. Up next for Collins and the Texans are the Ravens in Week 12, where the veteran receiver will remains an upside WR2 due to modest volume expectations.-Mark Garcia

item.title: David Montgomery rushed 26 times for 107 yards in the Texans’ Week 11 win over the Colts, adding 17 yards on three receptions.
item.description: Montgomery shook off a relatively slow start to reach 100 yards on the ground for the first time as a member of the Texans, doing so with Woody marks inactive due to a concussion. Veteran journeyman Emari Demercado handled just seven touches as the primary change of pace option. Montgomery churned out consistently positive yardage but managed just one explosive run, a 15-yard scamper to ice the game late in the fourth quarter. No longer a featured back at this point in his career, the 100-yard showing could go down as his top fantasy performance of the season with Marks expected back from injury when the Texans face the Ravens in Week 12. Treat Montgomery as a potential Flex option in that matchup.-Mark Garcia

item.title: C.J. Stroud completed 21-of-27 passes for 194 yards, three touchdowns, and one interception in the Texans’ 26-3, Week 11 win over the Colts, adding 27 yards on six carries.
item.description: Stroud’s lone mistake came on the team’s first possession of the game when a poorly thrown ball over the middle of the field intended for Nico Collins was picked off. He would go to work from there, completing nine of his next 10 passes while throwing two touchdowns before the half. A 17-3 lead at the break saw a slight uptick with a safety on the defense’s first time on the field in the second half, with Stroud tacking on his third touchdown throw on the following possession. The team would go into coast mode from there, eventually chasing Daniel Jones from the game with just over seven minutes remaining in the fourth quarter, with Stroud finishing with three or more touchdown passes for the fourth time in his last five appearances. Stroud and the Texans get the floundering Ravens in Week 12, where he will remain a back end QB1 in fantasy circles.-Mark Garcia

item.title: Tyler Warren caught 1-of-5 targets for 22 yards in the Colts’ Week 11 loss to the Texans.
item.description: The poor showing comes on the heels of a two-catch, one-yard performance in Week 10, leaving fantasy managers scratching their heads following the departures of Josh Downs and Keenan Allen at the trade deadline. Warren briefly departed in the second quarter after being shaken up on his lone reception but returned to do absolutely nothing else for the remainder of the game. The Colts gained only 165 yards of total offense with Daniel Jones under center through almost 53 minutes of play, something that has become a routine occurrence of late. Fantasy managers will want to confirm the starting quarterback ahead of a Week 12 meeting with the Giants before considering entering Warren into lineups. Even so, there appears to be no good option currently on the roster.-Mark Garcia

item.title: Ashton Dulin caught 2-of-4 targets for 30 yards in the Colts’ Week 11 loss to the Texans.
item.description: Both of Dulin’s receptions came on the opening possession of the game, with a 25-yard catch down the sideline sparking the drive that led to the team’s only points. The Colts remain a veritable disaster at present, leaving nobody on the weekly fantasy radar - Dulin most certainly included.-Mark Garcia

item.title: Anthony Gould caught 2-of-3 targets for 48 yards in the Colts’ Week 11 loss to the Texans.
item.description: Gould played sparingly despite the recent wide receiver departures, with his team-leading 48 yards more a statement on the current state of the offense than anything else. Nobody on this sinking team deserves fantasy consideration, a sentiment that extends to its depth pieces.-Mark Garcia

item.title: Jonathan Taylor rushed 11 times for 21 yards in the Colts’ Week 11 loss to the Texans, adding six yards on four receptions.
item.description: Taylor went as the rest of the offense went in this one, with the team gaining just 165 yards of total offense through almost 53 minutes of play with Daniel Jones under center before the veteran signal caller was replaced by Anthony Richardson. The only points mustered for the duration of the contest came on the opening possession of the game, sparked by a 25-yard completion to Ashton Dulin down the sideline. Taylor again rotated with Seth McGowan in a 1A-1B situation until the latter was forced from the game with a hamstring injury sustained on a kick return to end the first half. The team has no reason to run Taylor into the ground in a lost season, significantly capping his fantasy value in the process. Fantasy managers will want to confirm the starting quarterback for the Colts entering a Week 12 meeting with the Giants before inserting Taylor into lineups.-Mark Garcia
